name: Claymorphism
intent: Make family routines feel soft, touchable, and reassuring, so a parent can see the next small step and a child can celebrate it.
bestFor: Family planning and shared routines for children aged 6–12
Products whose interface is made of tiles, badges, avatars, and progress
Welcoming consumer marketing that must stay legible and calm
avoidFor: Dense operational dashboards that need tight type and hard edges
Offers that cannot show a truthful product state without decoration

compatibility.foundationVariables: Proposed additions, not existing runtime variables.
